---
title: Salviata
id: MAR-0067
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 50
difficulty: medium
---
## Ingredients
- 2 tablespoons grated Pecorino Romano
- 2 tablespoons grated Grana Padano
- 1 tablespoon all-purpose flour
- 8 eggs
- 10 sage
- 1 dl milk
- 20 g butter
- to taste Salt and pepper
## Method
1. Wash and chop the sage leaves.
2. Crack the eggs into a large bowl, add the sage leaves, the cheeses, the flour, the milk, a grind of pepper, and salt.
3. Beat with a fork, mixing the ingredients well.
4. Melt the butter in a saucepan and pour in the egg mixture.
5. Cook over medium heat, stirring continuously with a wooden spoon.
6. When the mixture has become a cream, remove from the heat and serve the salviata with bread croutons.
